item.title: Pops Mohamed mixed old and new to reinvent South African music
item.description: By Gwen Ansell Ismail Mohamed-Jan – better known by South African jazz fans as Pops Mohamed – has passed away at the age of 75. His life in music represented a struggle against narrow, oppressive definitions – of race, instrumental appropriateness and musical genre. A few days before his death, a remastered version of his 2006 album Kalamazoo, Vol. 5 (A Dedication to Sipho Gumede) had been released on digital platforms ahead of an official launch. item.title: Nigerian rapper Shallipopi releases 22-track album AURACLE
item.description: Nigerian rapper and songwriter Shallipopi has released a new 22-track album, AURACLE, marking the latest addition to his growing discography. The release is accompanied by a new single, ‘Like That’ featuring Wizkid, which follows a series of collaborations that have widened the artist’s international profile. item.title: MIAF appoints advisory committees for fundraising and risk oversight
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) has appointed a team of experts to serve on two newly established advisory committees. The committees were created to support the board in discharging its fiduciary duties and will focus on critical areas such as fundraising, membership strategies, human resources and risk management. item.title: 2025 TikTok Sub-Saharan Africa Awards: All the winners
item.description: The 2025 TikTok Awards Sub-Saharan Africa took place in Johannesburg on 6 December, recognising digital creators from across the region for their influence in culture, storytelling and online engagement. Held under the theme New Era, New Icons, the ceremony focused on content creators who have built significant audiences and shaped online trends on the platform. item.title: Beyond The Beat: AI, law and gender equity in music
item.description: On 28 November 2025, the Black Coffee Foundation hosted Beyond The Beat: Conversations With Black Coffee at The Venue in Johannesburg, South Africa. item.title: SA: Black Motion rework Lisa Ramey’s Better Than That
item.description: South African producer duo Black Motio has released an Afro-house remix of New York-based R&B singer Lisa Ramey’s track ‘Better Than That’, through Lisa Ramey Music. The remix, which is available for streaming and download on major digital platforms, features a percussion-driven reworking of the original song, which appeared on Ramey’s 2024 EP Foretaste. item.title: Ngeke Festival launches at Constitutional Hill with music-led call for accountability
item.description: By Siphokazi Ndlovu and Goitsemang Kemp On 6 December 2025, Constitutional Hill in Braamfontein hosted the inaugural Ngeke Festival, an event that positioned music and performance as tools for addressing corruption and its effects on young people and marginalised communities in South Africa. item.title: Big Zulu appointed as brand ambassador for SA’s passenger rail network
item.description: The Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) has announced the appointment of hip hop artist Big Zulu as its official brand ambassador in a bid to reinforce public trust and promote rail travel across the nation. Big Zulu, known for his storytelling and connection to everyday South Africans, will lend his profile to PRASA campaigns and commuter outreach efforts. item.title: Cover star interview: Ugandan Afro-pop artist Joshua Baraka
item.description: Rising Ugandan Afro Pop artist Joshua Baraka joins Nandi Madida via FaceTime on Apple Music to talk about her latest single ‘State of my Heart’. item.title: Internship opportunities in media and creative fields at the MIAF
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) invites young, passionate and unemployed individuals to apply for internship opportunities offered through the Foundation’s Internship Programme, aimed at providing valuable work experience.
